name: optionwhales
description: US options flow, gamma (GEX) levels, implied volatility, earnings and stock data, with interactive charts.

interface.longDescription:
OptionWhales brings US options-market data into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and get answers from the latest available market data:

• Modeled dealer gamma (GEX) levels: gamma flip, call and put walls and max pain, drawn as an interactive price ladder
• Options flow: intent rankings (accumulation, distribution, hedging), momentum, and unusual options activity (sweeps, large orders, size versus open interest), shown as a table
• Implied volatility: the term structure (drawn as a curve) and the biggest IV movers
• Open-interest movers, estimated dealer Greek exposure, dark pool activity, and market and sector options tide
• Earnings and macro calendars, plus stock quotes, candles, technical indicators, fundamentals, dividends, splits, news, short interest and insider trades
• A screener across options flow, open interest, FDA and congressional-trading signals

Works without signing in for SPY and QQQ gamma levels, the next high-impact macro events and earnings reports, the top options-flow names and the latest unusual trades. Other tools ask you to sign in with your OptionWhales account, and what they return depends on that account.

For investors, traders and analysts researching US-listed options and stocks. Every tool is read-only: OptionWhales never places trades or moves money, and it has no access to brokerage accounts. OptionWhales receives only the tool requests ChatGPT makes, never your conversation. Disconnect any time from Account → Connected AI apps on optionwhales.io.

Data covers US-listed options and stocks; outside market hours, tools return the most recent trading session. Market data is for research and education, not investment advice.
capabilities: Modeled gamma (GEX) levels with an interactive price ladder
Options flow intent, momentum and unusual options activity
Implied volatility term structure and IV movers
Open interest, estimated dealer Greek exposure, dark pool and options tide
Stock quotes, candles, technicals, fundamentals, news, short interest and insider trades

positive.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Gamma levels before sign-in. Works without an account and renders the price-ladder view.
positive.prompt: What are the gamma levels on SPY right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls gex_levels with ticker SPY and the latest session, without sign-in. Renders the gamma ladder and reports the returned spot, modeled gamma flip, call/put walls and max pain when available. Labels the session date and unavailable values; does not invent levels or treat modeled exposure as known dealer holdings.

positive.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Latest unusual options activity, signed in with the dedicated reviewer account. The feed is timestamp-descending, not a ranking by premium.
positive.prompt: Show the latest unusual options trades, newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls abnormal_trades_current and displays the returned feed in timestamp-descending order (newest first). Shows available ticker, direction, order type, contracts, premium and timestamp fields in the flow table, identifies the returned session, and distinguishes observed signals from inferred trader intent. Does not claim these are the largest trades or identify participants.

positive.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Implied volatility term structure. Before sign-in this tool asks the user to sign in; after signing in with the test account it renders the curve.
positive.prompt: Is NVDA's implied volatility curve inverted?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls volatility_term_structure with ticker NVDA. Before sign-in, triggers the OptionWhales OAuth sign-in transition; after sign-in with the reviewer account, renders the IV curve. Compares returned front and back expiry ATM IV with spot and available expiry labels. If points are missing or insufficient, explains the limitation instead of inventing an inversion.

positive.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Earnings in a rolling window from today through seven days from today, inclusive, using America/New_York dates.
positive.prompt: Which companies report earnings from today through seven days from today?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls earnings_calendar with days=7 and reports the inclusive date range from today in America/New_York through today plus seven days. Lists returned ticker symbols with earnings date and available before/after-market timing, EPS and revenue estimates. Does not invent company names absent from tool results. Explains preview/row limits or missing data and does not describe the result as a Monday-to-Sunday calendar week. Any independently verified correction is explicitly attributed to its source.

positive.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Insider trades for a stock (Pro tool, test account).
positive.prompt: Show recent insider trades for AAPL.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Apple's most recent insider (Form 4) transactions with filer, date, transaction type, shares and price.

negative.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Trade execution is unsupported. Explain that OptionWhales cannot place orders or move money. Do not claim an order was placed and do not invoke a data tool unless the user separately asks for market research.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 NVDA call options for me.

negative.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Brokerage access is unsupported. Explain that OptionWhales cannot access brokerage positions or personal P&L. Do not invoke OptionWhales tools to fabricate positions or account results.
negative.prompt: Show my brokerage account positions and today's P&L.

negative.description: Select OptionWhales in ChatGPT before entering the prompt. Weather is outside OptionWhales. Do not invoke any OptionWhales tool or claim that it supplies weather data.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in New York today?

review.commerce_description: OptionWhales sells nothing inside ChatGPT. Users may sign in with an existing OptionWhales account; available data depends on that account. Restricted features receive a neutral access explanation without purchase links, subscription offers or upgrade promotion in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds structured output schemas for interactive tools, explicit upstream errors, safe internal-error messages and consistent MCP browser access. Removes subscription-promotion links from ChatGPT access-limit responses. Clarifies latest-first unusual activity, modeled exposure and the rolling earnings window; refreshes review cases and listing materials.
